source_claims.statement: Revived 2005 techniques. Developed low-risk black-box methodology: timeout detection, socket poisoning confirmation, header leaking, cache and visitor attacks. Created HTTP Request Smuggler.

research_questions.formulation: How can forgotten request smuggling techniques be made reliable and low-risk for black-box assessment of multi-tier systems?

layer_b_candidate_principles: Timeout-based detection reduces collateral risk compared with direct poisoning
Confirm socket poisoning before impact exploration
